name: Abira (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Abira town emblem in blue, navy and green: a stylised letter A and B formed of light blue and dark blue strokes with a green leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Abira, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Abira town emblem — a stylised letter A and B formed of light blue and dark blue strokes with a green leaf
